product.name: Coba Business
product.description: A multi-currency account platform for North American companies to send, receive, and hold funds in USD, MXN, CAD, and EUR with support for local payments like SPEI in Mexico.

product.name: Coba Infrastructure
product.description: An API-driven financial infrastructure offering access to local banking rails in Mexico and the U.S., virtual multi-currency accounts, FX, and global payouts for fintechs and platforms.

product.name: Coba Professional
product.description: A financial platform for freelancers and contractors in Mexico to receive USD payments, generate tax invoices, and prepare SAT-compliant declarations.
